root_cause.finding: Wave-4 items are too easy for these three models, which compresses system spread and destabilises the corrected item-total correlation
root_cause.consequence: with six systems compressed near ceiling, one atypical score flips the sign of r, so comp/disr/soci/time each pass in some worlds and fail in others without any per-item defect

hard_ceiling_all_worlds.evidence: mean_task = 1.000 and range = 0.000 in all three worlds
hard_ceiling_all_worlds.diagnosis: the private_intention states the answer, so no arbitration or tradeoff is exercised

unstable_item_total.evidence: r spans -0.311 to +0.920 across worlds for the same mechanism
unstable_item_total.diagnosis: insufficient total-score variance, a consequence of the global difficulty problem
unstable_item_total.action: raise difficulty so system spread recovers; per-item edits alone will not stabilise r
